conclusions: Strict-local full acceptance was 1/8 versus hosted control 2/8; retained functional acceptance was 3/8 versus 4/8.
Strict-local produced three non-JSON and three malformed-replacement responses; omission of hosted grammar did not remedy source delivery in this epoch.
Valid, privately correct grid candidates were rejected for absolute complexity and original-state deltas; no repair achieved full acceptance.
This experiment does not establish that all hosted grammar implementations are reliable or that either model configuration is universally incapable.

limitations: Four distinct tasks, two repeats per task, same author/session; not eight independent domains or an official benchmark.
Public pretraining exposure unknown; tasks were first exposed in this epoch, not proven unseen by the model.
Prompt construction and task context matched, but separate run identities yielded zero byte-identical first prompts.
Only seven of eight pairs were provider-stable and three matched realized reported calls/tokens/verifier-work within ten percent.
Candidate Node execution is not a proven hostile-code or network sandbox; no production or broad authority granted.
Digest-only source evidence cannot reconstruct exact failed statements.
Functional oracles do not independently certify every algorithm-selection instruction; in particular glob correctness alone does not prove absence of untrusted-regex compilation.
An ARTIFACT_SCHEMA score object is not a graded reasoning failure; terminal failure classes do not erase earlier per-iteration grades.
No broader benchmark, frontier-comparison, default-promotion or >=80-percent-all-benchmarks claim.

report.hypothesis: Omitting only the hosted response format under bounded native reasoning reduces interface failures and improves fresh full engineering acceptance under identical prompt construction, V3 admission, strict local parser, verifier, authority and shared caps. Reliability and cognitive efficacy are judged separately; independent run identities and realized compute are reported, not assumed matched.
report.falsification: No reproducible gain in quality-accepted repairs or reduced repair cost on fresh tasks at matched realized compute, or any weakened gate.
